text:
Type: rounded tufted loveseat settee
Use: sitting, conversation; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: linen-look fabric, button tufting, exposed wood frame
Colors: light sand beige, warm honey wood
Shape: curved barrel back with deep button tufting, exposed wood trim on back and arms, single seat cushion, splayed tapered wooden legs, compact
Feel: warm, elegant, inviting
Goes with: cream walls, natural wood, linen textiles; farmhouse, French country or classic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Laurel Rounded Loveseat Sofa Settee Couch, 57.1"W, Sand
product.description: 57.1”W x 30.7”D x 31.9”H Sturdy hardwood frame with linen/viscose blend upholstery Elegant, vintage style with highly durable fabric for easy care and long life Curl up with a good book on this sleek rounded vintage loveseat. The exposed rustic wood frame and neutral linen-like upholstery allow it to blend with any décor while the tufted back and removable foam cushion promise good looks and durability. No assembly required. Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
